$comment: The kinds of an entry and the extensions of a name that say them: one map for every SIMAI Framework part that shows a file or a page by its type -- sf-tree's rows today; sf-file-upload, sf-file-download and sf-view's file cells to follow; Docara's static tree, Larena's files and ui-mail read the same words (owner decision C102, 2026-11-12; research ui-control control/research/2026-11-12-tree.md section 7 items 2-3). A kind is one of twelve words; its icon is a Material Symbols name of the Framework's icon font. An extension is matched on the name's last dot, in lower case. A kind without extensions is said by the host (kind) or by the entry's place (folder: it has children). Keep the words: they are public (an entry's kind).
